entities.summary: Vladimir Aleksandrovich Andrunakievich was a Soviet and Moldovan mathematician, known for his work in abstract algebra. He was a doctor of physical and mathematical sciences (1958), academician (1961) and vice-president of the Moldavian Soviet Academy of Sciences. Laureate of the State Prize of the Moldavian SSR (1972).
